rule: STAGE2_TRACKB_PLAN rule Z1: for a set and a body or head the R5 env with the zero action (head neutral, nominal plant, the condition's friction, stance start with the row's start seed and Stage 1's start noise, the condition's push, the delay through the bar's own wrapper, interference termination off) against the bar's row R0@0ms and R0@10ms, on the eight gated mu 0.9 conditions the set has references for, walk/v0.4_mu0.54 and walk/nominal, panel seeds 3042 and 3043 (40 episodes).  Compared: sha256 of qpos, qvel, ctrl, sensordata after every physics step the row ran; the same end.  Pass: every episode identical (identical == of; compared_steps == reference_steps in every episode).  This module's own reading, which is not the rule's wording: the gate's form is the ten conditions x two seeds x two delays with no cut (complete); a record of fewer (--conditions, --seeds, --delays, --cut-s) is a check of the command and says so (complete false): its exit code is that of the episodes it ran, and it is refused (nothing runs) when its record would lie under stage2/tb/gates/, where only the gate's form is written (Z1's check reads that record).  On the Stage 1 view the development form g8a.stock on monitor2.S1_CONDITIONS stands in (no bar set exists there; it is never the gate's form).
compare_rule: an episode is identical when (1) no digest (sha256 of qpos, qvel, ctrl and sensordata after a physics step) differs over the physics steps both ran, and the env ran every step the row ran; (2) the ends agree: if the row fell at physics step j, the env terminates in the env step that holds j (falls are read at env-step ends); if the row did not fall, the env does not terminate in any env step that lies wholly inside the row's steps (the env's last, partial step, up to 9 physics steps past the row's end, is not read).  The row runs round(seconds / dt) physics steps or to its fall, the env ceil of a tenth of that many env steps.  A row episode during which MuJoCo warned is not identical to anything

not_run.reason: no reference within the thigh twist and the leg drives: the built reference is over a leg drive's Stage 0 limit

at_command.zmp_note: recorded, not gated: the multibody ZMP's central difference at the command frame straddles the command

limits.zmp_frames: the warm-up frames up to two frames before the command

accel_filter.of: model CoM, along the planned heading: three-point second differences on the frames' own times, then interpolated to fs_hz for the filter; the first frame's from the computed frame before the command, the last frame its neighbour's
accel_filter.read_over: the move's own frames only: the history enters the filter, not the peaks

turn.appendage_rule: inside a move whose stride period T(p) is shorter than the walk's, the tail's and the neck's swing amplitudes are multiplied by (T(p) / T_walk)^2 (constant angular acceleration amplitude), for every set, look sets included; a look choice (lead's ruling 1)

look.feet: flat in every stance that ends after the instant (instant_phase) and no later than the end of the move's last ramp (flat_until_phase; null: none ends later); the walk's own law before and after (S2L-L10)

join_events.note: a reading, not a gate: the gate is join_command's warmup_zmp_max_mm
join_events.events_rule: within 3 frames of a planned lift-off or touchdown, or of a frame of the warm-up on which a stance foot rolls (no frame beyond either end of the warm-up)
